## 2. Clinical Philosophy & Standards of Care
1. **Biologically Restorative & Conservative**: Natural dental structures and tissue vitality are preserved wherever feasible. Procedures are selected based on clinical indication rather than commercial overtreatment.
2. **Specialist-Led Surgical & Periodontal Care**: Gum treatments, bone regeneration, and implant therapies are directly performed by Dr. Jinal Parmar, who holds an MDS degree dedicated to periodontology and alveolar bone biology.
3. **Sterilization & Infection Control**: Hospital-grade autoclave sterilization (Class B vacuum), individually sealed sterile instrument pouches, disposable barrier wraps, and continuous surface disinfection between patients.
4. **Transparent Estimates & Informed Consent**: Written, itemized estimates are presented before initiating multi-step treatments. No surprise charges.

## 3. Directory of All 35 Clinical Procedures

### A. Periodontal & Surgical Dentistry (MDS Specialist Level)
1. **Gum Flap Surgery (`/services/flap-surgery`)**:
   - *Indication*: Moderate to severe chronic periodontitis, deep periodontal pockets (>5mm) unresponsive to non-surgical scaling, and subgingival calculus.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Local anesthesia, delicate incision, mucoperiosteal flap reflection, thorough ultrasonic and curette debridement of infected granulation tissue, bone contouring if needed, and microsurgical suturing.
   - *Recovery*: 5-7 days for soft tissue closure; suture removal at 7-10 days; chlorhexidine oral rinse prescribed.

2. **Bone Grafting (`/services/bone-grafting`)**:
   - *Indication*: Alveolar ridge resorption, vertical/horizontal periodontal osseous defects, and post-extraction socket preservation before dental implants.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Placement of biocompatible osteoconductive/osteoinductive bone particulate biomaterials, protected by resorbable barrier collagen membranes.

3. **Scaling & Root Planing (`/services/scaling-root-planing`)**:
   - *Indication*: Chronic gingivitis and early-to-moderate periodontitis with pocket depths of 4-6mm.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Ultrasonic supra- and sub-gingival debridement, followed by Gracey curette root planing to remove endotoxins and smooth root cementum.

4. **Gingivectomy & Gingivoplasty (`/services/gingivectomy`)**:
   - *Indication*: Drug-induced or inflammatory gingival hyperplasia, gummy smiles, and pseudopockets.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Resection and artistic scalloping of excess fibrous gum tissue to restore physiologic gingival architecture.

5. **Crown Lengthening (`/services/crown-lengthening`)**:
   - *Indication*: Subgingival tooth decay, tooth fracture below gingival margin, or insufficient clinical crown height for retention of a prosthetic crown.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Surgical apical repositioning of gingival tissue and minimal ostectomy to re-establish the biologic width (2-3mm).

6. **Frenectomy (`/services/frenectomy`)**:
   - *Indication*: High maxillary labial frenum causing diastema (gap between front teeth) or restrictive lingual frenum causing ankyloglossia (tongue-tie).
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Conservative surgical excision of the fibrous band under local anesthesia.

7. **Dental Implants (`/services/dental-implants`)**:
   - *Indication*: Single, multiple, or full-arch missing teeth with adequate bone foundation.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Diagnostic digital evaluation, surgical placement of grade IV titanium fixture into the jawbone, osseointegration period (3-4 months), and final precision porcelain/zirconia crown restoration.

8. **Splinting (`/services/splinting`)**:
   - *Indication*: Periodontally mobile anterior teeth or post-traumatic dental stabilization.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Flexible or rigid fiber-reinforced composite splint bonded to the lingual/palatal surfaces.

9. **Abscess Drainage (`/services/abscess-drainage`)**:
   - *Indication*: Acute periodontal or periapical bacterial swellings with fluctuant purulence.
   - *Clinical Protocol*: Immediate incision and drainage, antiseptic irrigation, antibiotic therapy when indicated, and definitive etiology resolution.

---

### B. Preventive, Restorative & General Dentistry
10. **Routine Exams (`/services/routine-exams`)**: Comprehensive oral cancer screening, hard-tissue caries detection, periodontal probing, and low-dose digital radiography.
11. **Teeth Cleanings (`/services/teeth-cleanings`)**: Ultrasonic prophylaxis to eliminate calculus, extrinsic nicotine/tea stains, and bacterial biofilm.
12. **Dental Fillings (`/services/dental-fillings`)**: Direct biomimetic composite resin restorations bonded to enamel and dentin with shade-matching.
13. **Tooth Extractions (`/services/tooth-extractions`)**: Minimally invasive extraction preserving socket walls and surrounding bone.
14. **Emergency Dentistry (`/services/emergency-dentistry`)**: Prompt management of acute pulpitis, broken restorations, tooth avulsion, and facial pain.
15. **Pediatric Dentistry (`/services/pediatric-dentistry`)**: Preventive fluoride varnishes, pit & fissure sealants, deciduous pulpectomy, and habit counseling.
16. **Root Canal Treatment (`/services/root-canal-treatment`)**: Complete extirpation of necrotic or inflamed dental pulp, rotary biomechanical canal preparation, irrigation with sodium hypochlorite, and hermetic obturation with gutta-percha.
17. **Crowns & Bridges (`/services/crowns-bridges`)**: Monolithic zirconia, E-max lithium disilicate, and porcelain-fused-to-metal (PFM) restorations for compromised teeth.
18. **Dentures (`/services/dentures`)**: Cast partial dentures, flexible Valplast dentures, and high-impact acrylic complete dentures.
19. **Teeth Whitening (`/services/teeth-whitening`)**: Clinical peroxide-based photo-activation for deep dental stain reduction.
20. **Composite Bonding (`/services/composite-bonding`)**: Conservative cosmetic addition for diastema closure, incisal edge wear, and chip repair.
21. **Porcelain Veneers (`/services/porcelain-veneers`)**: Custom fabricated 0.3-0.5mm ceramic shells bonded to enamel for long-lasting aesthetic correction.
22. **Night Guards (`/services/night-guards`)**: Dual-laminate thermoformed occlusal night guards to prevent sleep bruxism tooth wear.
23. **Sports Mouthguards (`/services/sports-mouthguards`)**: Custom multi-layer EVA athletic mouthguards providing impact dispersion.

---

### C. Facial Aesthetics & Cosmetology (FFAC Fellowship Level)
24. **HydraFacial Treatment (`/services/hydrafacial-treatment`)**: Patented vortex-cleansing, salicylic/glycolic acid exfoliation, painless suction extraction, and hyaluronic acid peptide infusing.
25. **Face PRP Treatment (`/services/face-prp-treatment`)**: "Vampire Facial" utilizing concentrated autologous platelets and growth factors micro-injected to stimulate dermal fibroblasts, collagen I/III synthesis, and skin elasticity.
26. **Hair PRP Treatment (`/services/hair-prp-treatment`)**: Intradermal scalp micro-injections of platelet growth factors targeting the dermal papilla to prolong the anagen hair growth phase.
27. **Chemical Peel (`/services/chemical-peel`)**: Controlled chemoexfoliation with AHA/BHA (glycolic, salicylic, lactic, mandelic) for acne, melasma, and texture refinement.
28. **Dermaplaning (`/services/dermaplaning`)**: Physical stratum corneum exfoliation using a sterile surgical blade for smooth skin texture and enhanced product absorption.
29. **Microneedling (`/services/microneedling`)**: Automated micro-puncturing inducing the natural wound healing cascade for acne scar remodeling and pore tightening.
30. **Carbon Laser Peel (`/services/carbon-laser-peel`)**: Liquid carbon emulsion application followed by 1064nm Q-switched Nd:YAG laser photo-acoustic vaporisation for deep pore clearing.
31. **Plasma Pen Skin Tightening (`/services/plasma-pen-skin-tightening`)**: Micro-electrical arc sublimation causing immediate tissue contraction and collagen remodeling for hooded eyelids and peri-oral rhytids.
32. **Mesotherapy (`/services/mesotherapy`)**: Intradermal micro-droplet delivery of polyrevitalizing cocktails (vitamins, amino acids, coenzymes, HA).
33. **Laser Skin Rejuvenation (`/services/laser-skin-rejuvenation`)**: Non-invasive optical stimulation targeting epidermal pigmentation and dermal elastosis.
34. **Eyelid Xanthelasma Removal (`/services/eyelid-xanthelasma-removal`)**: Precise, minimally invasive removal of periocular lipid plaques.
35. **Milia & Skin Tag Removal (`/services/milia-skin-tag-removal`)**: Sterile electro-dessication and micro-enucleation of keratin cysts and benign acrochordons.
